note: Measurement tool costs (docs/168 §9, Measurement cost rule PLAN.md 2026-10-24). Keys are the names tools/harness/hitch-ab.ts toolsOn() prints. msPerS = sim-thread ms per second the tool costs (null = not measured). timing: yes = allowed in timing runs with its cost taken off, after = light, allowed once its tool-cost.json job has a result, no = correctness runs only. costJob: the tools/harness/queues/tool-cost.json job(s) that measure it and the method (docs/168 §9). bundles: costs measured for several tools together; taken off when all members are on.

CrashForensics.Light.costJob: two-load ABBA bp-cf-light-off-1 / -on-1 / -on-2 / -off-2 (tools/harness/queues/forensics-light-cost.json, 10 min each; start-time only, no runtime switch); also the pair bp-tc-cflight-off-1 / -on-1 in tool-cost.json
CrashForensics.Light.how: [CrashForensics] Light=1 (docs/67 §18, 0.36.72; also the light half of Enabled=1): no detour on a game path. Ring entry per P5 EA new/free and g_rpUse hold (~30-60 ns, thousands/s at most, route worker + the cut), heap check at our own frees (2 reads), P5c park/release lines (first 4096 each, ~120 per session in Crash O), our-events ring per destroy/deferral/save step/refcount hold/route job (~30-60 ns, a few hundred/s), fault dump (fault time only: AV in TS3W .text or any illegal instruction). Estimate < 0.2 ms/s in all, sim thread < 0.05 ms/s [inferred]; taken off as 0 until bp-cf-light-ab has a result; queue.ts sets it in every job

CrashForensics.Guards.how: [CrashForensics] Enabled=1 Guards=1 (default with Enabled): check-only detours on game code: 0x5EE1E0 EASTL map erase (shared, every thread, call rate not measured; ~5-10 ns, ~1 ms/s at 100k/s), 0x7B0A00 array clear, 0x958560 transform parent (per world-matrix update, recursive; thousands/s while Sims move) [inferred]; crash reruns / correctness runs

CrashForensics.DrawGuards.how: [CrashForensics] Enabled=1 DrawGuards=1 (docs/186 §8): four check-only draw guards on the main thread (~1-2 ns per call: model part 0x6F6B5B, resource 0x6FA2DB, effect entry 0x71D562, shader binding 0x68FDA4; <= ~2 ms/s at 50k bindings per frame, inferred); crash-hunt runs

CrashForensics.EffectLog.how: [CrashForensics] Enabled=1 EffectLog=1 (docs/186 §9): four vtable slot swaps on the Swarm render list, a 64-byte ring entry per add / remove / gather (~50-80 ns: QPC + 48-word stack scan), a counter read per draw call; < 0.1 ms/s main thread, inferred; crash-hunt runs

CrashForensics.ObjResLog.how: [CrashForensics] Enabled=1 ObjResLog=1 (docs/186 §10): seven call-site retargets on the SceneModel model handle; ~40-60 ns per scene model node update (2-5k/s while lots stream): ~0.1-0.3 ms/s main thread, inferred; crash-hunt runs

CrashForensics.DbIndexLog.how: [CrashForensics] Enabled=1 DbIndexLog=1 (docs/67 §16): release ring at 0x72DB80 (rare: package open / close / refresh) + check-only detour at DatabaseIndex_Contains 0x72DBD0 (~20 ns per package probe of every resource lookup; tens of thousands/s while streaming: ~0.2-1 ms/s, inferred, sim + loader threads); crash reruns

CrashForensics.SceneTreeGuard.how: [CrashForensics] Enabled=1 SceneTreeGuard=1 (docs/67 §17): check-only detour at SceneNode_FindRecursive 0xC5FA60, one vtable read per visited node (~5 ns); every WorldManager_FindLotById walk (footprint updates, lot lookups) visits the scene list: calls/s not measured, ~0.1-1 ms/s sim thread, inferred; crash reruns

M2LotDump.how: [RouteSnap] M2LotDump=1 / M2Box (docs/94 §24.8.4, p4lotdump.h, 0.36.50): no hook; on the P4/P5 worker only, after an M2/M3 compare or a compare whose start/goal is in M2Box, at most M2LotDumpMax (16) per session: one lot-table walk + the start lot's Q cells in the route box, clone and live (one +0x918 try, no wait), a few hundred us per dump, inferred; the sim thread pays only when the try lands while it waits for +0x918 (rare). Rides on RouteSnap Mode=1/2 correctness runs (already timing: no), no cost job

RouteSnap.audits.how: clone audits (AuditEvery / VerifyEvery / ReplayAudit*) compare whole snapshots
